newsitem.title: USA: Executone lowers 1997 per share estimate.
newsitem.headline: Executone lowers 1997 per share estimate.

text.p: Executone Information Systems Inc said on Monday that its first-quarter results were lower than planned and that it may fall short of its full-year targets by up to $0.07 per share.
Executone reported a first-quarter profit of $0.01, which bettered the loss of $0.10 it had for the same period a year ago but was lower than its planned $0.02 per share profit.

Executone said current estimates for 1997 range from $0.20 per share to $0.26, but it now projects full-year revenues in the range of $185 million to $195 million and net income in the range of $0.14 to $0.19 per share.
The company said the current estimates exclude any effect of its Unistar subsidiary, which has launched a test roll-out of the Coeur d'Alene Tribe's national lottery game.

First-quarter results were lower than expected mainly due to a $1.9 million revenue shortfall at the company's computer telephony distribution channel and a $1 million shortfall in call center revenue, Executone said.
Executone makes voice and data communications systems.
